limits: Current matched inventory, not a census of all apartments or past construction-time facilities.
Installation flags and positive-count confirmation are distinct; missing counts are never zero.
Count/household distributions exclude unknown counts and are not an all-complex average.
Unknown-status bounds are explicit extreme assumptions, not confidence intervals.
Repeated observations are reported-record changes, not actual installation dates or operation status.
Gyeonggi is the collected scope; Incheon is absent. Rounded 100% does not establish universal availability.
